overlap.title: Replacement tablets separate preparation from writing
overlap.summary: Moses prepares replacement stones; the text attributes writing in more than one way.
overlap.reasoning: Cutting stone and writing are different actions. The identity of the final writing subject and the relation between covenant words and tablet words are interpretive questions, not resolved merely by noting Moses cut the stones.
overlap.scope: This identifies attribution and reference questions in the account. Manuscript, Hebrew syntax and composition research remain needed; no definitive authorship or archaeological claim follows.
